description:
## Why
fz lets a guard call any local def (38 fixtures do; lib/ does not). Elixir refuses: "cannot find or invoke local first/1 inside a guard". That is the only blocker for 00623, 01114 and 01115 becoming their own oracle.

## Decide with the owner
- Refuse (Elixir): a local call in a guard is a spanned diagnostic suggesting defguard. The 38 fixtures move their helpers to defguardp, or keep a fz-only subject and keep a twin. 00623, 01114 and 01115 convert to Elixir form with `# oracle: self` and their twins are deleted.
- Keep it as an fz extension: no compiler change; 00623, 01114 and 01115 keep their twins and are listed by the fixtures.md ticket.

## Signal
Refuse: a diagnostic fixture for a local call in a def head, case, receive and fn guard; no local-call guard left in the repo; three fewer twins; full gate green.
title: A guard calls only guard-safe functions and defguard guards, as in Elixir
